description: This file defines the `GenericRestController` class, which extends `AbstractRestController` and handles REST API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for resources. It dynamically initializes API endpoints based on request attributes and provides common logic for request handling, validation, and response formatting within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A controller class managing generic REST API operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for various resource endpoints, with dynamic endpoint initialization and standardized response handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the API endpoint based on request attributes. Throws exceptions if `_api` attribute is missing or class does not exist.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests. Retrieves single resource or collection based on request parameters.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Determines validation rules for GET requests, depending on whether it's a retrieval of one resource or a collection.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new resources, ensuring the endpoint supports creation.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for POST requests for resource creation.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update resources, ensuring the endpoint is a resource endpoint.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for PUT requests for resource updates.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests, supporting deletion of resources or collections.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for DELETE requests.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the API endpoint does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines whether the incoming request is for a single resource based on ID parameters.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response data including normalized result, meta, and relations for API output.
